candidate_relations.reason: Despite fever and organ dysfunction, no infectious source or culture is supplied, while marrow contains 26% metachromatic giant-granule blasts characteristic of mast-cell lineage.
Pancytopenia, circulating blastoid cells, and a hypercellular marrow establish a hematologic malignancy category, but the mast-cell lineage and leukemic subtype are omitted.
The blasts have eccentric nuclei, abundant cytoplasm, coarse metachromatic giant granules, and spindle forms rather than lymphoblast morphology.

case_quality_flags: The morphology strongly suggests mast cell leukemia, but the excerpt omits mast-cell immunophenotyping, serum tryptase, and KIT testing needed to firmly establish lineage and classification.
